'''María Cumplido Cabello''' (25 April 1992) is a Spanish mathematician and researcher who in 2020 was awarded the Vicent Caselles Mathematical Research Prize of the [[Royal Spanish Mathematical Society]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=7 July 2020 |title=Los Premios Vicent Caselles de la RSME y Fundación BBVA reconocen la excelencia investigadora de 6 jóvenes matemáticos |url=https://www.europapress.es/epsocial/responsables/noticia-premios-vicent-caselles-rsme-fundacion-bbva-reconocen-excelencia-investigadora-jovenes-matematicos-20200707115325.html |access-date=14 July 2020 |website=www.europapress.es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-10-30 |title=Hablamos con María Cumplido, una de las mejores matemá́ticas de España, "Sale má́s a cuenta trabajar en un supermercado que dedicarte a la ciencia y la investigación" |url=https://www.mujerhoy.com/actualidad/maria-cumplido-mejor-matematica-espana-resolvio-problema-20211030122123-nt.html |access-date=2022-02-12 |website=Mujer Hoy |language=es}}</ref>

== Career ==
Cumplido was born in the Santa Rosa-Valdeolleros neighborhood of Córdoba, Spain.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Córdoba |first=Diario |title=María Cumplido: "Nunca he trabajado en España porque no he podido" |url=https://www.diariocordoba.com/noticias/cordobalocal/maria-cumplido-nunca-he-trabajado-espana-porque-no-he-podido_1378483.html |access-date=14 July 2020 |website=Diario Córdoba |language=es}}</ref> She graduated in [[Mathematics]] from the [[University of Seville]]<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |date=30 June 2020 |title=La cordobesa María Cumplido, premio de investigación en Matemáticas Vicent Caselles |url=https://cordopolis.es/2020/06/30/la-cordobesa-maria-cumplido-premio-de-investigacion-en-matematicas-vicent-caselles/ |access-date=14 June 2020 |website=Cordópolis |language=es-ES}}</ref> and spent a year at the [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in Paris.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=maripazmoguer |date=19 August 2019 |title=María Cumplido, de las playas de Isla Cristina a obtener el segundo premio a la mejor tesis en Matemáticas de la fundación francesa de Rennes |url=https://huelvabuenasnoticias.com/2019/08/19/maria-cumplido-de-las-playas-de-isla-cristina-a-obtener-el-segundo-premio-a-la-mejor-tesis-en-matematicas-de-la-fundacion-francesa-de-rennes/ |access-date=14 July 2020 |website=Huelva Buenas Noticias |language=es}}</ref>

She obtained a master's degree in Advanced Mathematics at the University of Seville and a Collaboration Scholarship from the Ministry of Education in the Department of Algebra.<ref name=":3" /> He also received a scholarship from the Ministry of Education in the Department of Algebra and was awarded a scholarship to study mathematics at the University of Seville, where she studied for a year.<ref name=":3" />

She received her PhD from the University of Seville and from the [[University of Rennes]]. She was recognized for her thesis.<ref name=":2" /> Cumplido was a postdoctoral researcher at the [[University of Burgundy]] in Dijon and spent a month research stay in [[Oaxaca]], Mexico.<ref name=":3"/> In October 2019 she became a postdoctoral researcher at Heriot-Watt University in [[Edinburgh]]. She has also worked at the [[Complutense University of Madrid]] and is currently a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Seville.

She has focused her research in the field of [[geometric group theory]] and has succeeded in generalizing geometric and [[Topology|topological]] results on [[braid group]]s to the algebraic context of Artin-Tits groups of spherical type,<ref name=":2" /> thus solving a mathematical problem that had been unsolved for 20 years.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Cortes |first=Agathe |date=13 July 2020 |title=Una investigadora resuelve un problema matemático abierto desde hace 20 años |url=https://elpais.com/ciencia/2020-07-13/una-investigadora-resuelve-un-problema-matematico-abierto-desde-hace-20-anos.html |access-date=14 July 2020 |website=El País |language=es}}</ref> This field of research is potentially applicable in [[cryptography]] and [[computer security]].<ref name=":0" />

== Awards ==
In 2018 she won the second prize of the Rennes 1 Foundation for the best thesis in Mathematics and Science and [[Information and communications technology|Information and Communication Technologies]].<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=La cordobesa María Cumplido recibe el segundo premio a la Investigación Matemática |url=https://www.cordobabn.com/articulo/personas/matematica-cordobesa-maria-cumplido-premio/20200704123828051901.html |access-date=14 July 2020 |website=Córdoba Buenas Noticias |language=es}}</ref>

In 2020 she was one of six young mathematicians to receive the Vicent Caselles Mathematical Research Award of the Spanish Royal Mathematical Society and the BBVA Foundation.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=López |first=Nerea Diez |date=2020-07-03 |title=Premios de Investigación Matemática Vicent Caselles de la RSME y la Fundación BBVA 2020 |url=https://www.rsme.es/2020/07/premios-de-investigacion-matematica-vicent-caselles-de-la-rsme-y-la-fundacion-bbva-2020/ |access-date=2021-07-29 |website=Real Sociedad Matemática Española |language=es}}</ref>
